protocol.name: RELATIVE_MOMENTUM_STOP_COMPATIBILITY_RISK_LADDER_V1
protocol.period_note: Seven completed daily01UTC-to01UTC cycles; freeze before collecting; current incomplete cycle excluded
protocol.ranking: Unchanged7-day return top/bottom20%, positive LONG/negative SHORT, historical previous24h turnover proxy>=5M, fixed26 current survivors
protocol.volatility_stop: Original arm:2*simpleATR14 daily. Corrected arms: smaller of original adverse distance and estimated liquidation adverse distance/1.6 from entry fill. No TP, same24h exit.
protocol.entry: Daily01UTC following00UTC decision, one-hour execution delay
protocol.sizing: Prior equal margin slots now multiplied by L to form desired notional, then jointly reduced so modeled stop risk<=2%equity and initial margin+two execution fees<=equity; current min/step/max lots
protocol.margin: Isolated per position, fixed leverage10, no automatic margin addition
protocol.liquidation: Threshold estimated from entry notional, current MMR tier and liquidation fee: entry*(1-sign/L+sign*(MMR+liq_fee)); historical fair-price H1 used to test crossing
protocol.liquidation_charge: Conservative loss of allocated initial isolated margin, entry fees and previously held funding; liquidation charges absorbed in forfeited margin, no double exit fee
protocol.ambiguity: If Fair liquidation and Last stop both touched in same H1, count liquidation first and flag ordering uncertain
protocol.funding: Historical signed settlements; debit available cash, no margin topups; assert cash available beyond locked margin sufficient; H1 marks
protocol.stop_validity: Original arm retains unsafe stops for reproduction. Corrected arms cap stops before sizing, assert final maintenance tier unchanged and1.5 buffer satisfied; still simulate Fair H1 liquidation if touched.
protocol.control: Same100USD period at1x for paired interpretation, same risk cap and ranks; no parameter optimization
limitations: H1 execution and liquidation ordering cannot prove actual fills
Only seven completed cycles, not broad validation
protocol.stop_adjustment: Keep original 2ATR stop if closer; otherwise cap adverse distance from execution entry at estimated liquidation distance/1.6. Use minimum lot margin tier before sizing; assert resulting quantity is still in that same tier. No TP added; same ranks and 24h exit.
protocol.comparison: First change only stop at2% portfolio risk, then hold corrected stop constant and increase joint risk to5% and10%. Recompute quantities and equity each cycle. No searches or chosen best setting.
protocol.interpretation: Exploratory same historical week reused after prior results; not out-of-sample or approval for live risk. Risk budget is planned per daily basket, not per trade; gaps/liquidation may exceed it.

limitations: Exploratory reuse of the same seven completed cycles after baseline results; no independent validation.
Fixed26 current survivors and retrospective lot/MMR/contract rules.
Stop cap is a new exit rule; does not establish a valid market-structure stop.
H1 Last/Fair, modeled fills, funding timing and approximate liquidation; intrahour losses may be larger.
Changing size changes min-lot feasibility, hence trade counts; 2%versus5% is not the identical executed basket.
All arms use isolated10x and no auto margin topup; risk percentages refer to whole daily portfolio, not each position.
